app.title: Show HN: PS2 games statically recompiled to WebAssembly
app.author: deadxwarrior
app.description: A project that statically recompiles PlayStation 2 binary executables to WebAssembly, enabling them to run in browsers.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and install dependencies via npm.
Run the build command on a sample PS2 executable and verify a .wasm file is produced.
Execute the generated wasm in a browser or node and check for expected output.
Measure build time and compare to original binary size.
